answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigate new types of computational primitives for transformers based on Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) which are explicitly-compositional vector embeddings of symbolic structures. ... for the task of abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models using automatic metrics including ROUGE F1 score and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to compare the summaries generated by the Transformer and our TP-TRANSFORMER.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which summary is better in terms of grammar, coherency, faithfulness, saliency, repetition, and overall preference.
